Select compounds with IC50 measurements in nM against human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by target name 'Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic', target organism 'Homo sapiens', standard_type 'IC50', and standard_units 'nM'. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
